firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently cooked something is the first round's starting player.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: That player shuffles the fortune-teller cards, keeps the deck, and reads the opening card aloud.
Players brew their potions simultaneously; the starting-player role does not mean drawing ingredients before everyone else.
